title: Kadison's similarity conjecture

result.label: Kadison's similarity conjecture
result.statement: Proves Kadison's similarity conjecture: every bounded complex-linear unital algebra homomorphism from a unital complex C ∗ -algebra to operators on a Hilbert space becomes a -homomorphism after conjugation by a bounded invertible operator.
